title: Leeuwis2021: Left- vs right-hand motor-imagery EEG dataset
description: Single-session EEG recordings from 55 healthy, BCI-naive participants performing two-class left- versus right-hand motor imagery. Data were acquired with a 16-channel g.Nautilus system at 250 Hz, with one calibration run and three feedback runs. The dataset was collected to study psychological and cognitive predictors of motor-imagery BCI performance, and is re-released in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: Participants performed cue-based left or right hand motor imagery with visual cues. One calibration run without feedback was followed by three feedback runs of 40 trials each (20 per class). EEG was recorded from 16 channels (F3, Fz, F4, FC5, FC1, FC2, FC6, T7, C3, C4, Cz, T8, CP5, CP1, CP2, CP6) at 250 Hz with a g.Nautilus amplifier, referenced to the right earlobe with ground at AFz.
